sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Medical Stable

system.description:
You manipulate the water and iron in the atmosphere to make a spinning disk of blood that encircles you in the air. As a bonus action, you can fire a flurry of blood pellets at a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack, dealing 4d6 necrotic damage on hit and forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Bleed on a failure.

Blood Detonation. On a hit the blood pellets detonate, causing shrapnel of coagulated blood to spread, affecting all creatures within 5 feet of the original target, except the original target, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw vs gaining 1 rank of Bleed on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cat at C-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Bleed inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, when you make an attack with this jutsu, you can select two creatures, instead of one.
